literal_meaning: ঘরের দিকে মুখ করে থাকা (facing towards home)
figurative_meaning_en: devoted or attached to one's family
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একজন ঘরমুখো ব্যক্তি, সর্বদা পরিবারের সঙ্গে থাকতে পছন্দ করে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a home-loving person who always prefers to stay with his family.
history: This idiom is part of the proverb 'ঘরমুখো বাঙালী, রণমুখো সেপাই', which contrasts the peaceful, family-focused nature of Bengalis with the battle-ready disposition of soldiers, reflecting cultural stereotypes in Bengali folklore.
note: The proverb highlights traditional Bengali values of family attachment.
